ننتهك (form VIII)
# نَنْتَهِكُ (nantahiku) /nan.ta.hi.ku/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# نُنْتَهَكُ (nuntahaku) /nun.ta.ha.ku/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# نَنْتَهِكَ (nantahika) /nan.ta.hi.ka/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# نُنْتَهَكَ (nuntahaka) /nun.ta.ha.ka/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
